chunks.text:
MOWRAM information About the Ministry The Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology serves as a staff member for the Royal Government of Cambodia on the leadership and management of the water resources and meteorology sector, including the work of the National Mekong Committee of Cambodia and the Tonle Sap Authority.
This mission is carried out through the proper preparation and implementation of policies, legal frameworks and other legal documents related to the leadership and management of the water resources and meteorology sector, including the work of the National Mekong Committee of Cambodia and the River Authority.
Sow.
The Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology has the following functions and duties: Establish policies and strategies for the development of water resources and meteorology for national, international business, development, and sustainable protection in accordance with the Royal Government's political program.

Privacy Policy Privacy Policy MOWRAM Human Resource Management System (HRMS) Data Controller: Ministry of Water Resources and Meteorology (MOWRAM), Kingdom of Cambodia Address: Contact for privacy matters: info@mowram.gov.kh Version: 1.1.1 Effective date: 15 August 2026 1.
Introduction This Privacy Policy explains how MOWRAM collects, uses, stores, shares and protects personal data within the MOWRAM Human Resource Management System ("HRMS", "the System"), including its web application and mobile application.
The HRMS is an internal administrative system used to manage the employment records of MOWRAM civil servants, contract staff, interns and other personnel ("Users", "you").
It is not a public service and is not open to general public registration.
By using the HRMS you are acting in your capacity as a MOWRAM employee or authorised user.
Use of the System is subject to this Policy and to MOWRAM’s internal IT and personnel regulations.
2.

Who is responsible for your data MOWRAM is the data controller and owner of all personal data held in the HRMS.
The System was developed and is maintained by MISTEAMS, which acts as a data processor on MOWRAM’s instructions under a written service agreement.
The processor may not use HRMS data for its own purposes.
3.
Personal data we collect Depending on your role and the modules enabled, the HRMS may process: a) Identity and contact data Full name in Khmer and Latin script, sex, date and place of birth, nationality, national identity card number, passport number, family book / residence details, photograph, home address, personal and official phone numbers, personal and official email addresses.
b) Employment and civil-service data Employee/civil servant ID number, framework and rank, grade and step, position and job title, department or unit, duty station, date of appointment, contract type and dates, promotion, transfer, secondment and retirement records, employment history.

e) Biometric authentication The mobile app may use your device’s built-in fingerprint or face unlock to confirm your identity when you sign in.

Posted on: 06-09-2023 | View: 2813 | Share =========== On Tuesday, the 5th day of the month of Srap, in the year of Thao, Panchasak, B.C.
On September 5, 2023, Meteorology and Chairman of the Water Resources and Meteorology Coordination Working Group in Kratie and Stung Treng Provinces, accompanied by HE Run To, Under Meteorology.
The director of the department and his colleagues province.
During the inspection, the Secretary of State, accompanied by the Undersecretary of State and the Director of the Provincial Department, inspected the water situation at the Lower Sesan 2 Dam in Stung Treng Province.
According to the report of the director of the department, the water level in the Lower Sesan 2 Dam is 75.26 meters above sea level, which appears to be a bit high, but did not cause the water level in the Sesan River.
The lower part encounters abnormal problems.

Posted on: 12-09-2023 | View: 2947 | Share On the morning of Saturday, September 9, 2023, HE accompanied by His Excellency the Permanent Secretary of State, Undersecretary of State, Director of the Cabinet, Director of the Department, and officials.
Experts inspected the water condition and met with the community of farmers using water at Makak Irrigation System in Chi Kreng District, Siem Reap Province.
On that occasion, the HE Minister and his team, with the participation of the Deputy Provincial Governor, Chi Kreng District Governor, and Commune Chief, after meeting with 35 people from three water user communities, including Makak community, Area 1 and Afterwards, HE Minister and his team inspected the Makak Dam water controller and inspected the potential of the reservoir area and irrigation system.
Please be informed that the Makak Irrigation System has been continuously maintained and repaired by the community, the Department, and Meteorology.

chunks.text:
With the source of water flowing from the upper Chi Kreng River to the lower part of the Tonle Sap River, the Makak Irrigation System, which was built in 1973 in Makak Village, Kork Thlok Leu Commune, Chi Kreng District, Siem Reap Province, is able to irrigate a large amount of rice during the rainy season.
25,000 hectares of dry rice, 8,000 hectares, and mixed crops of 1,000 hectares, of which 2,061 families benefited from this irrigation system.
The Minister instructed to continue to strengthen the existing water farmers 'communities and requested all water farmers' communities to continue to help maintain the existing achievements to be able to use in the long run.
In the afternoon of the same day, the HE Minister also continued to inspect the water condition and the Tang Krasang irrigation system in Santuk district # Kampong Thom province.

chunks.text:
It should be noted that Tang Krasang Irrigation System, located in Santuk District, Kampong Thom Province, was built during the Pol Pot era and can store 25 million cubic meters of water and can irrigate 8,360 hectares of wet paddy and 2,150 hectares of dry paddy.
Tang Krasang irrigation system has two parts: the reservoir section is located in Kbal Bei village, Tipor commune, and the canal system is located in four communes: Tipor commune, Tang Krasaing commune, Chrob commune, and Kor Koh commune.
